tasks.answer: Delete-discussion confirmation uses ConfirmationDialog (exported from @/components/ui/dialog, source components/ui/dialog/confirmation-dialog/confirmation-dialog.tsx). Required props: triggerButton (React.ReactElement), confirmButton (React.ReactElement), title (string); body, cancelButtonText, icon ('danger'|'info'), isDone are optional.

LoginForm uses the Input component (@/components/ui/form, source components/ui/form/input.tsx). It binds react-hook-form via the required registration prop, passed as registration={register('email')} / {register('password')} inside Form's render prop, and Input spreads {...registration} onto the native input; label and error (formState.errors[...]) are optional FieldWrapper pass-through props.

DiscussionsList renders <Table> with a pagination prop; Table forwards it to TablePagination (components/ui/table/pagination.tsx, exported from that module only, not from the @/components/ui/table barrel). TablePagination requires totalPages: number, currentPage: number, rootUrl: string, and builds hrefs as `${rootUrl}?page=${page}`.

DiscussionView renders the body with MDPreview (@/components/ui/md-preview, source components/ui/md-preview/md-preview.tsx). It takes a single required prop value: string, parses it with marked, sanitizes with DOMPurify and injects via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

CreateDiscussion (features/discussions/components/create-discussion.tsx) takes no props; it wraps a FormDrawer + Form (title/body Input/Textarea) in <Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}>, so only users with the ADMIN role see and can use the create trigger.

notes: Checksum: wc -c sum of the 17 files above = 39980. Search strategy: listed apps/react-vite/src/components and features directories with find, then read the ui primitives (confirmation-dialog, dialog barrel, input+field-wrapper, table+pagination, md-preview) and the auth/discussions feature components that consume them, confirming usage sites (LoginForm, DeleteDiscussion, DiscussionsList, DiscussionView, CreateDiscussion). Duplicate components exist in apps/nextjs-app and apps/nextjs-pages; only apps/react-vite paths are reported, and import paths use the react-vite '@/' alias. Nuance: TablePagination is exported only from components/ui/table/pagination.tsx, since components/ui/table/index.ts re-exports just './table'; Table's own required props are data and columns (pagination optional). Input's required prop is registration (typed Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn> but non-optional); label/error are optional FieldWrapper props. No component-catalog CLI or catalog JSON was used and no project files were modified.
